objectives_fil: Matukoy ang angkop na pagtulong, paggabay, at follow-up ayon sa pagsasanay at pangangasiwa.
objectives_en: Identify appropriate assistance, guidance, and follow-up within training and supervision.

sections.takeaway_fil: Bahagi ng primary care team; katuwang ng midwife.
sections.takeaway_en: Part of the primary care team; a partner to the midwife.

sections.takeaway_fil: Halimbawa ng koordinasyon. Sundin ang lokal na referral at emergency procedures.
sections.takeaway_en: A coordination example. Follow local referral and emergency procedures.

sections.takeaway_fil: Mga halimbawa lamang. Gawin ayon sa pagsasanay, lokal na patakaran, at pangangasiwa.
sections.takeaway_en: Examples only. Work within training, local policy, and supervision.

sections.takeaway_fil: Ang follow-up ay nagpapatuloy sa ugnayan ng residente at health team.
sections.takeaway_en: Follow-up sustains the connection between the resident and health team.

sections.takeaway_fil: Makinig, tumulong sa loob ng saklaw, gumabay, at mag-follow-up kasama ang health team.
sections.takeaway_en: Listen, assist within scope, guide, and follow up with the health team.

check.prompt_fil: Humingi ng payong lampas sa iyong pagsasanay ang residente. Ano ang angkop?
check.prompt_en: A resident asks for advice beyond your training. What is appropriate?

options.fil: Hulaan ang sagot para hindi siya maghintay.
options.en: Guess so the resident will not wait.

options.fil: Humingi ng gabay sa health team at ipaliwanag ang susunod na hakbang.
options.en: Seek health-team guidance and explain the next step.

options.fil: Sabihing tapos na ang iyong tungkulin.

check.feedback_fil: Ang paggabay sa angkop na health worker ay pagtulong. Panatilihin ang hangganan ng pagsasanay at sundin ang lokal na tagubilin sa follow-up.
check.feedback_en: Guiding someone to the appropriate health worker is assistance. Respect training boundaries and follow local follow-up instructions.

assets.alt_en: Teaching, community discussion, and guiding a resident.
